The '''Hotel Imperial''' was a [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] and [[Erisi Dlarit]] stayed there during their [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|mission]].
